question: Among the posts with a score of over 5, what is the percentage of them being owned by an elder user?
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "posts_users" AS SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.score AS score, CAST(p.ouid AS BIGINT) AS owner_user_id, u.age AS owner_age FROM table_1 AS p LEFT JOIN table_2 AS u ON CAST(p.ouid AS BIGINT) = u.id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conductor_s_execution" AS
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT post_id, score, owner_user_id, owner_age
  FROM posts_users
  WHERE score > 5
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_posts_score_gt_5,
    SUM(CASE WHEN owner_age IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_with_known_age,
    SUM(CASE WHEN owner_age >= 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS elder_posts
  FROM filtered
)
SELECT
  total_posts_score_gt_5,
  posts_with_known_age,
  elder_posts,
  65 AS elder_threshold_age,
  CASE WHEN total_posts_score_gt_5 > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * elder_posts / total_posts_score_gt_5, 2) ELSE NULL END AS elder_pct_among_all_posts,
  CASE WHEN posts_with_known_age > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * elder_posts / posts_with_known_age, 2) ELSE NULL END AS elder_pct_among_known_age
FROM stats
